name: Stonecoil Serpent
oracle_text:
Reach, trample, protection from multicolored
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: a protection quality 'multicolored' on the `protection` static (e.g. `from_multicolored: true`), matched in `characteristics._matches_protection` against a source with two or more colors (derived on the battlefield, printed elsewhere), so damage, blocking, targeting and enchant/equip from multicolored sources are stopped
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `protection` static and `grant_protection` op name qualities only by from_types, from_subtypes, from_colors, from_colorless and from_everything; listing all five colors in from_colors would be protection from every colored source, not just multicolored ones, and there is no sentinel like PROTECTION_COLORLESS for 'multicolored'
